palette_rationale: One fixed species palette: all62 approved Idle colors plus2 actual resized native-render mouth RGB samples. Direct nearest-RGB mapping before any per-action quantization; no dithering. Same64-color mapping in every action. Idle PNGs untouched. Mouth colors reserved, not painted onto non-mouth geometry.
reference: RawAsset Sprite/0353 Shuppet: hovering draped body; missing Sleep/Shoot/Charge timing and hold conventions only. No horn, limbs, facial anatomy or effect transfer.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Native cyclic forward body tilt and low-hover bob, verified side audition. No feet or arms invented. Full1.6s loop; J_root XZ translation stabilized, native Y/deformation retained.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Native rise and forward/upward body lunge, contact around.75-.9s with mouth/body pitching and rim trailing; front/side auditions show real body deformation. Recovery sampled near native endpoint.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Native raised-mouth body release with a more horizontal forward pitch than ba01; special-action interpretation, not a verified native projectile. Pinned hovering Shuppet Shoot copies Charge, supporting body-only special gesture/timing convention. No generated projectile or pupil.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Native subdued low-hover rest and breathing. Source-white eyes stay open in GLB; close only visible source-eye masks with blue body fill and horizontal lid, preserving UV3 surrounds and occlusion. Six-pose long/short hold rhythm informed by pinned Shuppet Sleep [10,10,18,10,10,18]; retimed to200ticks native cycle.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Native early tip-back impact and body wobble/recovery; explicit impact samples rather than uniform idle-looking frames. Low rim may approach ground during recoil; audit all pixels.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Native body lunge with restrained procedural whole-body yaw [-30,+35] to make a lateral body/rim sweep. No hand/arm strike.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two retimed native ba01 body-lunge cycles. Visual contacts2/8; only engine HitFrame2, no invented second gameplay damage event.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Distinct native high-rise jump arc verified front/side. J_root native Y reaches.969 versus.086 start and returns; child pitch/rim deformation retained. Sampled gap reaches27px, unlike the2-5px Idle hover. Shadow remains fixed, no synthetic vertical translation.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Native body stretch/raised mouth gathering pose, clearly taller/narrower at midclip; retimed buildup guided by pinned Shuppet hovering-body Charge convention. No energy graphic or fabricated mouth anatomy.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Native hopping full yaw turn. Key-track evidence shows most rotation at1.933-2.133s; dense front auditions verify side/rear occlusion there. Retimed dense phases make the turn visible instead of skipping it with uniform samples. Native Y/rotation preserved; no synthetic camera spin.
